worldcombat.skill.retaliate.summary: Avenge a fainted ally: charge straight at the enemy; if an ally just fell, this blow doubles, and the closer the fallen ally the heavier it lands, spent only once it connects.
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.use.0: Hit back the moment an ally falls
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.use.1: Deliver a doubled charge carrying the grief
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.use.2: Charge the enemy that just struck your ally
The charge deals %1$s physical (Normal) power; if an ally just fell it doubles, scaling with level and friendship.
Charges %1$s blocks at %2$s per tick with a hit radius of %3$s blocks; on contact it shoves the target %4$s blocks and draws %5$s speed lines.
